curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When two people planning separate futures instantly hit it off, navigating messy wedding commitments becomes an impossible tightrope.
curatedMovie.description: After being dumped on his wedding day, local rock star turned wedding singer Robbie meets waitress Julia as she prepares for her own wedding.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and warm. An easy-watch romantic comedy moving at a breezy medium pace perfect for date night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This comedy-romance lets two people with wedding plans discover a more complicated connection after they meet.
